label.label: Field label
label._note: Renders as <label class="sgs-form-field__label"> — no per-instance colour/font-size/weight attribute exists on this block; the label is styled entirely by shared framework CSS across all six form-field siblings. clusters: [] is a genuine gap, not hidden — building per-field label typography/colour controls is future per-block work, not this manifest.

input.label: Text input
input._note: Renders as <input class="sgs-form-field__input">. Fill, border, corner radius and shadow are this field's own (includes/forms/field-own-style.php, scoped to the field's uid class), for a field outside an sgs/form such as a search box; the names are the form's own field* names. Typography has no per-field attribute.

leading-icon.label: Leading icon
leading-icon._note: A Lucide icon inside the control's start edge (leadingIcon, leadingIconColour, leadingIconSize); the input's start padding clears it.

help.label: Help text
help._note:
helpText itself is field-behaviour content, not a style property (Bean's non-cluster rule) — the rendered

also carries no per-instance style attribute of its own. clusters: []. The conformance checker's orphan scanner reports helpText as an ORPHAN here (its element-key-as-fallback-prefix convention coincidentally matches help+Text); this is a known false-positive of the checker, not evidence of an unaccounted style control — helpText is intentionally content, not style, and out of scope to silence without editing the checker script.

error.label: Error message
error._note: Populated by client-side validation JS, not a block attribute; the <span class="sgs-form-field__error"> has no per-instance style attribute. clusters: [].

optionalTag.description: Shows the form's Optional tag after the label when the field is not required. The form sets the tag's text and look.

fieldBackground.description: Fill of this field's input. Empty = the stylesheet's surface colour.

fieldBorderWidth.description: This field's input border width as a box {top,right,bottom,left}, or one box per device. Empty = the stylesheet's 1px.

fieldBorderColour.description: Resting border colour of this field's input. Empty = the stylesheet's border colour.

fieldBorderRadius.description: This field's input corner radius, per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each {topLeft,topRight,bottomRight,bottomLeft}. Empty = the stylesheet's small radius.

leadingIcon.description: Lucide icon slug printed inside the start edge of the input (for example 'search'). Empty = no icon.

leadingIconColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the leading icon's stroke instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over leadingIconColour at render time.

leadingIconSize.description: Width and height of the leading icon as one CSS length. Empty = 1.25rem.
